dedupe_keys.name: rbod annotated satellite imagery for river barrier dam and weir object detection

description: RBOD (River Barrier Object Detection) is a training and test set for detecting river barriers such as dams and weirs in high-resolution satellite images, described in a Scientific Data descriptor. It holds 4,872 images with 11,741 hand-annotated oriented bounding boxes in five barrier classes, with labels in both PASCAL VOC and YOLO formats and a 70, 10 and 20 percent split into training, validation and test sets. The authors made it because records of small barriers are missing from existing inventories, as a step toward global identification of barriers. Coverage is 4,872 satellite scenes of river barriers; the sections read do not list the regions sampled. The data are a free download from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the authors advise cropping images into smaller patches before training, since full images raise memory use and lower accuracy. Simulation uses: building detectors that fill gaps in dam and weir inventories used for flood exposure studies. Related records: Global Dam Watch (data-global-dam-watch-database) and the Global Dam Tracker (data-gdat-global-dam-tracker).
name: RBOD, annotated satellite imagery for river barrier (dam and weir) object detection
notes: geographic_scope global reflects the stated aim of global barrier identification; the regions of the sampled scenes were not read.
